responsibility: Defines the HP-UX 11.31-specific `-munix=2003` option for the PA port. It sets `flag_pa_unix` to the UNIX 2003 level so the HP-UX headers and specs can emit the corresponding predefined macros and startup/link choices.
same_name_distinction: HP-UX 11.31 option definition file: unlike pa-hpux1131.h, it is limited to declaring munix=2003 via flag_pa_unix and does not contain the header-side startup or target-feature macros.
